usedFor: Postman holds API collections and Microsoft Excel keeps the tracker, so “New Collection” can run “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Collection” in Postman, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new collection is logged in an Excel table, so the team sees what exists without opening Postman.

watchOut: “Updated Collection” is polling and fires on every update, so “Add Row To Table” can log one collection many times.
